audit.method: All 18 files opened (cover or statements). Ten filings (FY2025, FY2024 original, 9M/H1/Q1 2024, Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1/H1 2026) had BS, IS and CF rendered and read by eye, with the text layer as second source where present. Eight scanned or image-heavy 2022-2023 filings were identified from rendered covers (and a contact sheet for H1 2023) and NOT read for values. tools/check_transcripts.py (BS identity, CF sum and roll, gross profit, quarter sums, declared restatements and footing defects) passes for transcripts/7201.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR whole. BS totals, income statement through net loss and EPS, and cash flow (CFO/CFI/CFF/net change/opening/closing cash) transcribed from rendered pages for FY2024 (original), FY2025, Q1/H1/9M 2024, Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1/H1 2026 (10 filings; Q1 2024 income statement only). Identities pass (BS equation, CF sum and cash roll, gross profit, quarter-sum chains) except one printed footing defect, declared. 80 cross-filing differences declared with both values and both filings: the FY2024 year is shown three ways (original FY2024 audit: loss 17,700,041, total assets 202,742,568, equity 121,858,641; H1/9M 2025 comparatives: total assets 203,904,985, equity 132,761,184; FY2025 comparatives restated Note 33: loss 23,602,702, total assets 200,271,635, equity 124,977,331). Q1 2025 loss -5,212,659 original vs -2,156,780 restated; H1 2025 loss -6,174,792 vs -4,853,613 restated; 9M 2024 cost of revenue -26,404,798 original vs -18,692,492 restated (amortisation moved). Which version is final for each period is a data-pipeline decision; this audit declares and does not choose.

defects.evidence: 8215c106 (FY2022), 485fdade (FY2023), f3ca5d48 (FY2024), 59c024d8 (FY2025) carry fiscal_year one above the period on the cover. Creates false gap 2022|FY and false extra 2026|FY.
45532a0b (scanned_unreadable) and b151a39c (other_no_statements_found) contain legible image statement pages (BS, IS, equity, CF).

FY2024 original (f3ca5d48) CF p10: printed CFO 17,290,136 is 1,000,000 more than its own components (16,290,136); the statement only foots to net change -293,427 with 16,290,136. The restated CFO in FY2025 comparatives is 12,821,236.

80 declared differences, see transcripts/7201.json restatements. FY2024 net loss -17,700,041 (original) vs -23,602,702 (FY2025 comparatives); 2024 equity 121,858,641 vs 132,761,184 (H1/9M 2025 comparatives) vs 124,977,331 (FY2025 comparatives).

H1 2025 filing: Q2 2025 loss -3,642,613 but 6M -6,174,792 minus Q1 original -5,212,659 = -962,133; the 6M figure is consistent with 9M (Q3 -3,358,889 ties) while Q1 original is not. In the H1 2026 filing the restated 6M 2025 (-4,853,613) equals restated Q1 (-2,156,780) plus restated Q2 (-2,696,833). Q2 by subtraction from the original filings would be wrong.

H1 2024 original: 6M provisions no longer required 333,646 but Q2 column 231,050 and Q1 2024 filing none; 102,596 not in either quarter, so Q1 plus Q2 pretax (-14,808,840) differs from the 6M (-14,706,244).

H1 2026 prints the 31 Dec 2025 balance sheet with total assets 200,399,744 and liabilities 95,151,539 versus 201,143,313 and 95,895,108 in the FY2025 audited and Q1 2026 filings (prepayments and accrued expenses netted by 743,569).
